indicator: Synthetic-drug production and storage sites dismantled
drug_specific: No (all synthetic drugs; MDMA and amphetamine dominate)
bias_limitations: Same series as for MDMA; enforcement-driven; amphetamine share unknown.

indicator: Methamphetamine labs dismantled
bias_limitations: Context only: methamphetamine is a different drug, but labs often share precursors, staff and dumping networks.

indicator: Dumpings of synthetic-drug waste
bias_limitations: Only dumpings found and reported. Amphetamine production is a likely large source of the waste, but the series is not split by drug and is shared with MDMA.

indicator: Costs of cleaning up drug waste
bias_limitations: No national series; candidate for a data request to provinces.

indicator: Pre-precursors seized, BMK-type (APAAN, APAA, MAPA, EAPA, BMK glycidates)
bias_limitations: Derived: sum of the BMK-type rows; total for all substances only to 2022. Few large seizures dominate the yearly total; the precursor mix shifts as substances are scheduled.

indicator: OM investigations into synthetic drugs
bias_limitations: Same series as for MDMA; measures prosecution capacity and priorities.

indicator: Amphetamine seized by Douane (kg and number of seizures)
bias_limitations: Since 2020 the number of seizures rose while kg stayed low, which points to many small consignments; Douane sees only border flows. Enforcement-driven.

indicator: Registered hard-drug (Opiumwet list I) offences
bias_limitations: Not amphetamine-specific; dominated by cocaine.

indicator: Street price of amphetamine (speed)
bias_limitations: Price reported by people handing in samples, not a market survey; interquartile range (€5–€10) unchanged.

indicator: Perceived drug use / dealing nuisance in neighbourhood
bias_limitations: Not drug-specific.

indicator: GI-TOC Organized Crime Index: synthetic drug trade score, Netherlands
bias_limitations: Only three points; expert judgement.

indicator: Amphetamine use, total population (lifetime, last year, last month)
bias_limitations: Self-report; general-population survey under-covers heavy and marginalised users. Two age bases of the same survey.

indicator: Lifetime amphetamine use among pupils 12–16
bias_limitations: Six points only; school surveys miss absent and dropped-out pupils.

indicator: Lifetime amphetamine use among mbo students
bias_limitations: Sampling of schools changed over waves; five points.

indicator: Clients in addiction care with amphetamine as primary or secondary problem
bias_limitations: Treatment demand, not need; constant-institution series diverges from all-institutions after 2021 (coverage changes).

indicator: General-hospital admissions with amphetamine as main or secondary diagnosis
bias_limitations: Coding practice; secondary diagnoses rose while main diagnoses stayed flat, which may reflect better recording as much as more harm.

indicator: Share of drug incidents involving amphetamine, by service
bias_limitations: Shares only; services and their totals change over time. First-aid and forensic-doctor series are in the data but not plotted.

indicator: Deaths from psychostimulants (incl. amphetamine and MDMA)
bias_limitations: Same series as for MDMA; not amphetamine-specific; small numbers.

indicator: Amphetamine residues in wastewater
bias_limitations: One sampling week a year; city set changes; residues can come from dumped production waste, not only use (notably Eindhoven).

indicator: Mean amphetamine content of speed samples
bias_limitations: Self-selected samples; five points; earlier years only in DIMS reports.
